hindi_topic: मृदा नमी स्तर एवं सिंचाई समय
guidelines: For most field crops, optimal soil moisture is 50-70% of Field Capacity. If capacitive/resistive sensor reads below 30-35% moisture in the root zone, light irrigation should be initiated. For loamy soil, moisture levels between 40-60% ensure active root respiration without anaerobic waterlogging.
precautions: Avoid heavy flood irrigation before forecasted rainfall to prevent root rot, aeration deficit, and lodging.

hindi_topic: फसलों में सिंचाई की प्रमुख अवस्थाएं
stages: Wheat: Crown root initiation (20-25 days - most critical), tillering (40-45 days), jointing (60-65 days), flowering (80-85 days), milking (100-105 days). Mustard: Rosette/branching (30-35 days) and siliquae formation (60-65 days). Gram/Pulses: Pre-flowering and early pod development (DO NOT irrigate during peak flowering to prevent flower drop). Rice: Continuous shallow ponding for first 10 days, Alternate Wetting & Drying (AWD) during tillering, and continuous ponding during panicle emergence to flowering. Potato: Tuber initiation and bulking.

hindi_topic: ड्रिप एवं स्प्रिंकलर सिंचाई एवं पीएमकेएसवाई अनुदान
benefits: Drip irrigation delivers 90-95% water use efficiency with 30-40% fertilizer savings through precision fertigation (19:19:19, 0:52:34). Sprinkler irrigation provides 75-85% efficiency, ideal for closely spaced crops like mustard, wheat, and pulses on undulating sandy terrain. PMKSY Per Drop More Crop (PDMC) offers up to 55% capital subsidy for small/marginal farmers (<5 acres) and 45% for general farmers in Uttar Pradesh via upagriculture.com.

topic: Safe Alternate Wetting and Drying (AWD) in Rice
hindi_topic: धान में सुरक्षित वैकल्पिक गीला और सूखा (AWD) तकनीक
guidelines: Uses a 30 cm perforated PVC/plastic field tube installed 15 cm deep into puddled soil. Re-irrigate to 5 cm depth only when water level drops 15 cm below soil surface inside the tube. Saves 25-30% irrigation water, cuts pumping energy costs, stimulates deep root anchorage, suppresses sheath blight, and lowers methane greenhouse gas emissions by 30-50% with zero yield penalty.
precautions: Suspend AWD and maintain 3-5 cm continuous standing water during the reproductive stage (panicle initiation to flowering).
